verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection-management platform, so an in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers MCP connections, OAuth and credential handling, publishing, triggers and a CLI tool search. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside the product, and the shutdown notice says the API, Connect and Toolbox services have stopped working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
